title: HR Analytics — Certificate Program
tagline: Turn recruitment and workforce data into clear metrics, trustworthy dashboards and responsible people decisions.
audience: Beginner undergraduate learners (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc) preparing for HR Executive, HR Analyst, Talent Acquisition Associate roles. No coding or prior industry experience required.
language: English; reflections and presentations may be in Kannada or Hindi by arrangement
weeklyCommitment: 6 hours per week: guided practice, independent study and portfolio projects
certificateTitle: HR Analytics Practice — Certificate of Completion
prerequisites: Basic arithmetic, percentages and comfort with spreadsheets or a willingness to learn
Access to a browser or shared college computer; offline spreadsheet alternatives are accepted
No paid tool subscription, live client account or real personal dataset required
outcomes: Frame recruitment and workforce questions with explicit populations, periods and decision owners.
Clean synthetic HR records and maintain data dictionaries, reconciliation checks and an audit trail.
Calculate recruitment funnels, duration and cost metrics using consistent cohort definitions.
Reconcile headcount and FTE and model turnover, retention, absence and workforce demand.
Interpret survey, onboarding and retention evidence with sample and causal limitations.
Build accessible dashboards and insight memos with tested filters and disclosure safeguards.
Recognise model errors, confounding, fairness concerns and the need for authorised human review.
Present a reproducible portfolio for HR Executive, HR Analyst and Talent Acquisition Associate roles.

conditions: At least three of four Project Blocks submitted
At least 75% attendance for instructor-led cohorts
Institutional award requires facilitator marking and integrity clearance; platform eligibility alone is not the award

components.name: Lesson quizzes
components.description: Best-attempt percentage averaged equally over all 24 lesson quizzes, scaled to 15 marks.

components.name: Project Blocks 1–4
components.description: Four applied portfolio projects, each marked out of 7 using the published rubric.

components.name: Capstone and presentation
components.description: An integrated simulation with traceable evidence, a five-minute pitch and individual questions.

components.name: Final assessment
components.description: A 90-minute assessment: 40 MCQs and two applied cases, scaled from 100 to 20 marks.

components.name: Reflection journal
components.description: Evidence of corrections, professional judgement and learning across all modules.

toolkit.note: All required analyses work in a spreadsheet; no coding or paid feature is required.
An offline aggregate dashboard is fully acceptable; public sharing of personal data is prohibited.
Do not upload real employee, payroll or candidate data to public AI tools.

modules.title: People analytics foundations and responsible questions
modules.summary: Translate an HR concern into an answerable question with a clear population, decision and privacy boundary.
outcomes: Connect recruitment and workforce measures to a practical decision without treating people as scores.
Map the employee lifecycle and document consistent definitions for HR reporting.
Apply minimisation, access controls and cautious reporting to sensitive workforce information.
